# #39 — feat: extend MCP/mcp2cli with lane-aware OB tools

## Goal
Harden and extend the Open Brain MCP/mcp2cli server surface for lane-aware memory operations.

## Motivation
Agents should call OB through tools, not hand-roll conventions in prompt text. The current operational failure mode is agents skipping OB or substituting Honcho/session vibes. First-class tools should make the right path easy.

## Proposed tool additions
- `start_session_lane`
- `session_context`
- `append_session_event`
- `link_entity`
- `wrap_session_lane`
- `list_active_lanes`
- `adjacent_context`

## Requirements
- Keep namespace/auth rules explicit.
- Return compact, receipt-friendly output.
- Avoid dumping large standing guidance into Discord/tool notifications.
- Gracefully degrade when OB is unavailable.
- Keep current tools (`search_brain`, `log_thought`, `log_decision`, `session_save`, etc.) backward-compatible.

## Acceptance criteria
- mcp2cli can call every new lane tool with JSON params.
- Tools are covered by tests.
- Errors identify the failed operation and do not leak secrets.
- Agents can recover active work after compaction/reset with a single lane lookup.
